data.name: Salvianolic acid B

identifiers_status.reason: Gene and protein identifiers do not apply to the type "Drug".

data.description: Polyphenol from Salvia miltiorrhiza that engages AKT1 and the AKT/mTOR/HIF-1α axis to promote angiogenesis and repair.

page_status.reason: By design: fewer than three linked studies and not a node on the pathway map, so no page is generated. The record is still served here and in the bulk exports.

data.description_beginner: A polyphenol from red sage (Salvia miltiorrhiza), used in Chinese medicine for circulation. In lab studies it binds AKT1 and drives the AKT/mTOR/HIF-1α chain that tells damaged tissue to build new blood vessels and repair itself.

studies.title: Salvianolic Acid B Enhances Motor Function Recovery after Spinal Cord Injury in Association with AKT/mTOR/HIF-1α Pathway Activation and Angiogenesis.
studies.authors: Yao J; Chen Yingfeng; Pan F; Zhang S

evidence.label: Animal model
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.finding: Salvianolic acid B improved motor recovery, neuronal survival and angiogenesis after rat spinal cord injury in association with AKT/mTOR/HIF-1α activation; the effects were reversed by the AKT inhibitor capivasertib.
